More than two years ago, a New York jury found him guilty on 34 felony counts of falsifying

Another look at Wall Street.
We see the Dows now down more than 1,700 points.
The Nasdaq down nearly 1,400 points.

NPR's Eleanor Beards-Lee reporting.

floods, droughts, wildfires, and sea level rise.

Developing countries will need $305 billion a year by 2035 to adapt to climate change

Next week, countries gather in Turkey for this year's UN Climate Conference, where

Julia Simon, NPR News.
I'm Lakshmi Singh, NPR News, in Washington.

topics.text: Wall Street sell-off: Nasdaq down over 5 percent, Dow down over 3 percent after midterm results
Democrats on pace for largest Senate majority in over a decade, House swing dramatic; Nevada and Alabama races flip
Voters' cost-of-living frustration drove midterm results as September inflation hit 3.6 percent
Trump attorneys seek to clear his name in New York hush money conviction case hearing
Hundreds of thousands protest across France over labor protections, pay, and school funding; general strike
UN report says wealthy countries falling short on climate adaptation funding, needing $305 billion annually by 2035
